meta.title: Hidden Edge - 4
meta.description: Facing the foe head on can be a wise strategy too.

units.rawText: Oh, what a tragic elegy.
units.displayText: Oh, what a tragic elegy.

spans.text: Oh, what a tragic elegy.

units.rawText: Odile soars into the sky while the Entropic hordes beneath her feet churn, clashing with the charging Sanctifiers at close quarters.
units.displayText: Odile soars into the sky while the Entropic hordes beneath her feet churn, clashing with the charging Sanctifiers at close quarters.

spans.text: Odile soars into the sky while the Entropic hordes beneath her feet churn, clashing with the charging Sanctifiers at close quarters.

units.rawText: Form up! Don't let them sweep you away!
units.displayText: Form up! Don't let them sweep you away!

spans.text: Form up! Don't let them sweep you away!

units.rawText: As expected of a loyal knight. Your resilience and resolve add color to this conclusion.
units.displayText: As expected of a loyal knight. Your resilience and resolve add color to this conclusion.

spans.text: As expected of a loyal knight. Your resilience and resolve add color to this conclusion.

units.rawText: However, it seems your underlings are not as intelligent as yourself, hm?
units.displayText: However, it seems your underlings are not as intelligent as yourself, hm?

spans.text: However, it seems your underlings are not as intelligent as yourself, hm?

units.rawText: [Major damage... detected...]
units.displayText: [Major damage... detected...]

spans.text: [Major damage... detected...]

units.rawText: [Alert... Individual processing error detected.]
units.displayText: [Alert... Individual processing error detected.]

spans.text: [Alert... Individual processing error detected.]

units.rawText: Refactor squad, keep up! Back row, prepare for point shooting!
units.displayText: Refactor squad, keep up! Back row, prepare for point shooting!

spans.text: Refactor squad, keep up! Back row, prepare for point shooting!

units.rawText: [Order received. Executing.]
units.displayText: [Order received. Executing.]

spans.text: [Order received. Executing.]

units.rawText: [Faith holds up her stout shield and directs the Sanctifiers from on high, gradually breaking up the Entropic offensive.]
units.displayText: [Faith holds up her stout shield and directs the Sanctifiers from on high, gradually breaking up the Entropic offensive.]

spans.text: [Faith holds up her stout shield and directs the Sanctifiers from on high, gradually breaking up the Entropic offensive.]

units.rawText: I see... You are an excellent leader.
units.displayText: I see... You are an excellent leader.

spans.text: I see... You are an excellent leader.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, you are still too big a target... Practically inviting people to attack you!
units.displayText: Unfortunately, you are still too big a target... Practically inviting people to attack you!

spans.text: Unfortunately, you are still too big a target... Practically inviting people to attack you!

units.rawText: Odile gestures and the Sprayers in the back row take aim and fire a volley at Faith.
units.displayText: Odile gestures and the Sprayers in the back row take aim and fire a volley at Faith.

spans.text: Odile gestures and the Sprayers in the back row take aim and fire a volley at Faith.

units.rawText: Unbreakable Dominion!
units.displayText: Unbreakable Dominion!

spans.text: Unbreakable Dominion!

units.rawText: Faith holds her shield high, and a white barrier forms over her head, directly in the path of the purplish-black bolts.
units.displayText: Faith holds her shield high, and a white barrier forms over her head, directly in the path of the purplish-black bolts.

spans.text: Faith holds her shield high, and a white barrier forms over her head, directly in the path of the purplish-black bolts.

units.rawText: The barrier gradually cracks under the tremendous explosions, but all the projectiles are stopped. However—
units.displayText: The barrier gradually cracks under the tremendous explosions, but all the projectiles are stopped. However—

spans.text: The barrier gradually cracks under the tremendous explosions, but all the projectiles are stopped. However—

units.rawText: A chance!
units.displayText: A chance!

spans.text: A chance!

units.rawText: As the purple smoke clears, Odile suddenly plunges downward in a power dive, aiming for the instant when Faith's head is exposed.
units.displayText: As the purple smoke clears, Odile suddenly plunges downward in a power dive, aiming for the instant when Faith's head is exposed.

spans.text: As the purple smoke clears, Odile suddenly plunges downward in a power dive, aiming for the instant when Faith's head is exposed.

units.rawText: However, Faith does not dodge. Instead, she turns aside and moves her shield away. Upon seeing the figure below the shield, Odile's eyes go wide.
units.displayText: However, Faith does not dodge. Instead, she turns aside and moves her shield away. Upon seeing the figure below the shield, Odile's eyes go wide.

spans.text: However, Faith does not dodge. Instead, she turns aside and moves her shield away. Upon seeing the figure below the shield, Odile's eyes go wide.

units.rawText: The petite Antonina looks up and smiles coldly at Odile.
units.displayText: The petite Antonina looks up and smiles coldly at Odile.

spans.text: The petite Antonina looks up and smiles coldly at Odile.

units.rawText: Hi~
units.displayText: Hi~

spans.text: Hi~

units.rawText: Try as she might, Odile cannot brake in the middle of her dive, and she is completely exposed to Antonina's attack.
units.displayText: Try as she might, Odile cannot brake in the middle of her dive, and she is completely exposed to Antonina's attack.

spans.text: Try as she might, Odile cannot brake in the middle of her dive, and she is completely exposed to Antonina's attack.

units.rawText: The operands swirling around Antonina instantly solidify and strike Odile a moment before she can dodge them.
units.displayText: The operands swirling around Antonina instantly solidify and strike Odile a moment before she can dodge them.

spans.text: The operands swirling around Antonina instantly solidify and strike Odile a moment before she can dodge them.

units.rawText: <size=40>NGHAAAAHH!!!</size>
units.displayText: NGHAAAAHH!!!

spans.text: NGHAAAAHH!!!

units.rawText: Is it... a DDoS... attack...
units.displayText: Is it... a DDoS... attack...

spans.text: Is it... a DDoS... attack...

units.rawText: But with my current operands... it can't...
units.displayText: But with my current operands... it can't...

spans.text: But with my current operands... it can't...

units.rawText: It's a bit too late for you to draw on Odette's share of operands now, isn't it?
units.displayText: It's a bit too late for you to draw on Odette's share of operands now, isn't it?

spans.text: It's a bit too late for you to draw on Odette's share of operands now, isn't it?

units.rawText: Impossible... Odette... Odette?
units.displayText: Impossible... Odette... Odette?

spans.text: Impossible... Odette... Odette?

units.rawText: Odile tries calling out to Odette, but only silence answers her.
units.displayText: Odile tries calling out to Odette, but only silence answers her.

spans.text: Odile tries calling out to Odette, but only silence answers her.

units.rawText: Odette... You... What have you done!?
units.displayText: Odette... You... What have you done!?

spans.text: Odette... You... What have you done!?

units.rawText: Odile knows things are looking very bad for her, and she immediately gathers all her Entropics to screen her. However, Antonina's attack immobilized her long before that.
units.displayText: Odile knows things are looking very bad for her, and she immediately gathers all her Entropics to screen her. However, Antonina's attack immobilized her long before that.

spans.text: Odile knows things are looking very bad for her, and she immediately gathers all her Entropics to screen her. However, Antonina's attack immobilized her long before that.

units.rawText: Go take a nap in the depths. We'll dredge you back up afterwards.
units.displayText: Go take a nap in the depths. We'll dredge you back up afterwards.

spans.text: Go take a nap in the depths. We'll dredge you back up afterwards.

units.rawText: Click.
units.displayText: Click.

spans.text: Click.

units.rawText: As she hits the Enter key, Odile closes her eyes, plunging into the endless sea of Entropics like a broken-winged swan.
units.displayText: As she hits the Enter key, Odile closes her eyes, plunging into the endless sea of Entropics like a broken-winged swan.

spans.text: As she hits the Enter key, Odile closes her eyes, plunging into the endless sea of Entropics like a broken-winged swan.
